requirements.text: * Bachelors \+ 8 years of related experience, or Masters \+ 6 years of related experience, or PhD \+ 3 years of related experience, or 10\+ years of related experience.
* 10\+ years of data center networking experience across design, deployment, troubleshooting, and operations.
* Experience with Cisco Nexus or comparable large\-scale data center switching platforms.
* Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) or equivalent experience.
* Experience delivering industry standard methodologies within customers’ data center infrastructure, including RoCEv2, PFC, BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, multicast, and PTP.
* Experience with Cisco Data Center networking offerings, including Nexus stand\-alone, Nexus Dashboard, software, and automation development.
* Experience serving as a technical leader across Cisco, customer, and partner organizations.
